summary: Workflow templates (document title assignment, notification email subject/body, webhook body/params) can now use a document's custom field values via {{custom_fields...}}; custom-field assignment now runs before the title is set so a title can use fields set by the same action.

statements.why: Templating feature for admin-configured workflows; no logins, money, data loss or secrets.

statements.text: Most of this change is in src/documents/workflows/actions.py (22 lines added).
statements.why: Largest net addition in code, though mutations.py has more lines touched (a block moved).

statements.text: The agent changed docs/usage.md, a notes file (not code).
The agent also changed consumer.py, templating/workflows.py, workflows/actions.py and workflows/mutations.py, in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: New feature: workflow titles, notification emails and webhooks can now include custom field values (e.g. an invoice number) using {{ custom_fields.Invoice.value }}.
Workflows now assign custom fields before setting the title, so a title template can use fields set by the same workflow action.
